# SoOptimal Contracting

> Painting and drywall contractor based in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Canada. Interior painting, drywall repair, plaster repair, drywall taping and finishing, and apartment turnover painting for landlords and property managers.

## Key facts
- Phone and text: (343) 305-1787
- Email: fernandconstructions@sooptimal.com
- Service area: Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph (all services); Kingston, Ontario (multi-unit residential projects)
- Hours: Monday to Friday 7am to 6pm, Saturday 8am to 4pm
- Quotes: free, usually within one business day, often from photos sent by text
- Owner-operated; repair and painting done by the same contractor
- Commercial general liability insurance and WSIB coverage; Working at Heights, aerial lift and WHMIS trained
- Drywall experience since 2019

## Services
- [Drywall repair](https://sooptimal.com/drywall-repair/): Drywall repair in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph. Holes, cracks, water damage and ceiling patches fixed and finished so the repair disappears under paint. Free quote from photos.
- [Drywall installation](https://sooptimal.com/drywall-installation/): Drywall installation in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph. Basements, additions, bathrooms and renovation walls boarded, taped and finished. Moisture-resistant and cement board for wet areas.
- [Plaster repair](https://sooptimal.com/plaster-repair/): Plaster wall and ceiling repair in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph. Cracks, loose and bulging plaster, failed patches and skim coating over rough walls. Free quote.
- [Interior painting](https://sooptimal.com/interior-painting/): Interior painting in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph. Walls, ceilings, trim and doors, with wall repairs done properly before any paint goes on. Free written quote.
- [Taping and finishing](https://sooptimal.com/drywall-taping-finishing/): Drywall taping, mudding and sanding in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph. Basements, additions and renovations finished to Level 4 or Level 5, ready for paint.
- [Rental unit turnovers](https://sooptimal.com/apartment-turnover-painting/): Unit turnover painting and drywall repair for property managers and landlords in Kitchener-Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph and Kingston. Per-unit pricing, photo reports, fast turnaround.

## Common questions
- **What does SoOptimal Contracting do?** SoOptimal Contracting is a painting and drywall contractor based in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario. Services are interior painting, drywall installation, drywall repair, plaster repair, drywall taping and finishing, and apartment turnover painting for landlords and property managers.
- **Which areas do you serve?** Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph for all services. Kingston, Ontario for multi-unit residential and property management projects.
- **How do I get a quote?** Text photos of the job to (343) 305-1787 or use the quote form. Most painting and repair jobs get a written price within one business day. Larger jobs get a site visit first. Quotes are free.
- **Do you do small jobs?** Yes. A single hole, one cracked ceiling or one room is fine. Small repairs are often quoted from photos and done in one or two visits.
- **Can you repair the wall and paint it too?** Yes. Repair and paint are quoted together and done by the same contractor, so the patch is primed and painted properly and you only book one trade.
- **Are you insured?** Yes. SoOptimal Contracting carries commercial general liability insurance and WSIB coverage. A certificate of insurance and a WSIB clearance certificate are available on request. The owner is also Working at Heights, aerial lift and WHMIS trained.
- **Do you work with landlords and property managers?** Yes. We offer fixed per-unit turnover pricing by bedroom count, with before and after photos of every room attached to each invoice.
